notes: Country-level VIZA RAG seed for malaysia. This file is the source of truth for this country's visitor/tourism visa knowledge and is designed to evolve alongside the country-specific form-filling workflow.

chunks.title: 中国护照马来西亚短期旅游签证建议
chunks.content: 中国护照持有人短期赴马来西亚旅游时，VIZA AI 应优先核查马来西亚移民局/外交部当前对中国公民的 social visit visa exemption 或 eVISA 规则。当前知识库范围覆盖旅游/社交访问；若用户目的为工作、学习、长期居留或多次商务活动，应提示需要不同准证或向官方确认。

chunks.title: Malaysia China/India short social visit exemption
chunks.content: Malaysia's visa liberalisation materials and Immigration pages state that citizens of China and India may be covered by a visa exemption for social visit purposes for up to 30 days. VIZA AI should avoid promising entry: the final decision is made by Malaysian immigration at the border, and travellers should still prepare passport validity, return/onward ticket, accommodation, funds, and any required arrival declaration.

chunks.title: Malaysia eVISA and arrival declaration
chunks.content: For travellers who are not visa-exempt or whose purpose/stay does not fit the exemption, route them to the official Malaysia eVISA portal and current Immigration Malaysia instructions. Malaysia also operates a digital arrival card/MDAC process for many foreign arrivals; VIZA AI should tell users to complete current official arrival requirements before travel and verify exemptions on the Immigration Malaysia site.

documents.title: Malaysia MDAC Arrival Card Form Requirements

chunks.title: Malaysia application channel and form scope
chunks.content: Use the standalone MY_MDAC_ARRIVAL_CARD package for Malaysia Digital Arrival Card preparation. Official source URLs reviewed for this seed: https://www.imi.gov.my/index.php/en/pengumuman/malaysia-digital-arrival-card-mdac/ ; https://imigresen-online.imi.gov.my/mdac/main. MDAC is not a Malaysia eVISA and must stay separate from visa-exemption or eVISA workflows. Route work, study, residence, immigration, journalism or other regulated purposes to a separate country workflow.

chunks.title: Malaysia fields to collect before filling the form
chunks.content: Malaysia MDAC intake should collect identity, passport, nationality, date of birth, sex, contact details, arrival/departure dates, mode of travel, transport number, last embarkation country/region, point of entry, purpose of visit, accommodation type, Malaysia address, and official declaration acknowledgements. Do not silently reuse Malaysia eVISA fields for MDAC.

chunks.title: Malaysia supporting documents and review checklist
chunks.content: MDAC preparation evidence should focus on passport details, travel itinerary, transport number, accommodation or Malaysia address, and contact details. Workflow guardrails: VIZA should distinguish visa-exemption, eVISA and MDAC. MDAC is not a visa and should be tracked as a separate pre-arrival declaration.

chunks.title: Standard passport identity-field answer rules
chunks.content: Standard-answer identity fields must be answered from the applicant's passport biodata page, official identity document, MRZ where that field is encoded, or the official form's dropdown options. This applies to passport number, name, date of birth, sex, nationality, issuing country, issue date, expiry date, issuing authority, place of issue, and passport/document type. Treat issuing country, place of issue, and issuing authority as distinct fields and never substitute one for another. Place of issue / 签发地点 asks for the location recorded on the passport or required by the official form, such as a city, province, municipality, or a country selected from an official country-only dropdown; copy the passport's Place of issue value when present, and enter a country only when the form explicitly asks for Country of issue / Issuing country or provides a country-only selector. Issuing authority / 签发机关 asks for the organization printed under Authority / Issuing authority. For Chinese ordinary passports, National Immigration Administration, PRC / 中华人民共和国国家移民管理局 and MPS Exit & Entry Administration / 公安部出入境管理局 are issuing-authority examples only and must never be suggested as place-of-issue answers. Do not infer either field from the pickup city, residence city, application country, or travel destination. If the passport prints a different value for the requested field, use that exact field value. For passport type, select Ordinary / Regular / Normal only for ordinary personal passports; select Diplomatic, Official, Service, Special, Travel document, Refugee, or Other only when the document explicitly indicates that type. Official sources reviewed for this standard field rule include China National Immigration Administration certificate-issuing-authority notices and the Passport Law of the People's Republic of China; the passport biodata page and the destination's official field wording remain the final sources for the applicant's individual answer.

chunks.title: Malaysia eVISA is separate from MDAC
chunks.content: Use MY_TOURIST_E_VISA only when a deterministic passport, purpose and stay rule confirms that the traveller needs or is eligible for the tourist eVISA route. MDAC is a separate pre-arrival declaration and must not be presented as a visa.

chunks.title: Malaysia eVISA application preparation
chunks.content: For travellers deterministically routed to Malaysia tourist eVISA, prepare official portal identity, passport, contact, travel, accommodation, photograph and supporting-document fields. Eligibility and permitted stay must come from current Immigration Malaysia rules. Do not copy MDAC-only fields into this visa workflow.
